definitions.description: Self-contained deployable definitions for the exported actions (source, runtime, entrypoint, parameters, metadata). Carried so an export -> import round-trips the actual function code with fidelity, not only the resource reference. Optional and additive (consumers that only read 'resources' are unaffected).

Self-contained deployable definitions to import (source, runtime, entrypoint, parameters, metadata). When present, the registry rows are created/updated from these; the scope is always re-stamped to the caller's verified tenant/workspace. Optional and additive.

FunctionDefinitionPayload.description: A single deployable function-definition payload inside an export/import bundle.

inlineCode.description: Inline source payload used when kind=inline_code.

storedObjectRef.description: Stored source reference such as a bucket object URI or managed asset key.
